title: Calling the server from a page
summary: A page gets data from the server through a client class. Mark the class with `HTTPClient` and its methods with `GetRequest`, `PostRequest` and the other request annotations. A service gets the client with `Needs` and calls its methods. In JavaScript, TypeScript, Dart, C#, F#, Rust, Go, Kotlin, Swift, Java and Ruby, a client whose Setup gives it no adapter sends its request through the browser to the server of the page, without cookies. A C++ client has no Setup, so it always uses this transport. This browser transport refuses every other origin. Lua cannot use `HTTPClient` (`TY1308`). A request to another host goes through a Setup adapter, and that host must be listed in `tac.outgoing.hosts`.
